answer: SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Death Touch';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN alignment a ON a.id = s.alignment_id WHERE a.alignment = 'Neutral';

SELECT s.superhero_name FROM hero_attribute ha JOIN superhero s ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE a.attribute_name = 'Speed' ORDER BY ha.attribute_value DESC LIMIT 1;
note: Speed is tied at the max value (100) across 40 heroes; this returns one representative row via ORDER BY ... LIMIT 1 as the evidence's MAX() formula implies a single top row.

answer: SELECT a.attribute_name, ha.attribute_value FROM superhero s JOIN hero_attribute ha ON ha.hero_id = s.id JOIN attribute a ON a.id = ha.attribute_id WHERE s.superhero_name = '3-D Man';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN g.gender = 'Female' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM superhero s JOIN publisher p ON p.id = s.publisher_id LEFT JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id WHERE p.publisher_name = 'Marvel Comics';
SELECT r.race FROM superhero s JOIN race r ON r.id = s.race_id WHERE s.superhero_name = 'Copycat';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN hero_power hp ON hp.hero_id = s.id JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Wind Control' ORDER BY s.superhero_name;
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hero_power hp JOIN superpower sp ON sp.id = hp.power_id WHERE sp.power_name = 'Stealth';

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN c.colour = 'Blue' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct FROM superhero s JOIN gender g ON g.id = s.gender_id LEFT JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.skin_colour_id WHERE g.gender = 'Female';
SELECT s.superhero_name FROM superhero s JOIN colour c ON c.id = s.eye_colour_id WHERE s.height_cm BETWEEN 170 AND 190 AND c.colour = 'No Colour';
